notes.trigger_below_ready: Ready stock = PLANNED topics a writer can still take (not claimed, drafted, published or on hold). Below this number a research order opens.
notes.round_target: One order asks external AI researchers for round_target_min..round_target_max NEW topics that pass Research QA. The order closes at round_target_min accepted topics.
notes.max_rounds: null = unlimited rounds. Only approved_capacity in production-policy.json (owner decision, hard ceiling 10,000) limits how many topics can ever be admitted.
notes.intent_guard: Search-intent collision thresholds used by Research QA and the trusted intake. FAIL can never be waived; REVIEW needs a written reason (and the current content hash for a WordPress page).
